content: Ketsutsi Nikuremu hamatɨa kememɨtekuxatakai
Merikɨtsɨ tewi 'aniuyeikakaitɨni paritseu mɨhɨkɨtɨkai Nikuremu titewatɨ, huriyutsixi tiwa'aitɨwamete mɨhɨkɨtɨkai.

Mɨkɨ Ketsutsi hetsɨa kaninuani yɨwikɨta, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Ti'ɨkitame, tame mɨpaɨ tekatenimaika, 'ekɨ Kakaɨyari hetsɨa pemiemetɨtɨ pemunuakɨ peti'ɨkitametɨtɨ, xewitɨ pɨkayɨwe 'ikɨ 'inɨarite mɨtiwewienikɨ kepemɨtiyuriene hepaɨ xɨka Kakaɨyari hamatɨana ka'uyeikanike.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, xɨka hutarieka ka'utinuiwa tewi, pɨkayɨwe mixeiya tita Kakaɨyari mɨra'aita.
Nikuremu mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —¿Tewi kehepaɨ tiyɨwe mutinuiwakɨ 'ukiratsitɨtɨri? ¿Tiyɨwe hutarieka yumaama hetsie meutahani mutinuiwakɨ?
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, hatsie meta 'iyaritsie xɨka ka'utinuiwa, pɨkayɨwe meutahani Kakaɨyari mɨra'aitatsie.
Tita tewitsie mɨtiyenuiwa kanitewitɨni, tita 'iyaritsie mɨtiyenuiwa kani'iyaritɨni.
Pepɨkahɨxiyaka mɨyanemetikɨhɨawekɨ: “Peuyewetse xeme hutarieka xemɨtinunuiwa”.
Kemɨtinake kaniu'ekani, pekani'enieka yuariyaya, perutsɨ 'atsipepɨkatimate kemɨraneika meta kemɨreumie. Mɨpaɨ mekani'aneneni yunaitɨ 'iyaritsie memɨyenunuiwa.
Nikuremu mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —¿Ketiyɨwe kuta mɨpaɨ mɨtiyɨnikɨ?
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —'Ekɨ 'ixaheritsixi pekatiniwa'ɨkitɨwametɨni, ¿kari 'ikɨ pepɨkatimate?
Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, tekatenikuxatani tita temɨtemate hepaɨtsita, tekatenihekɨatani tita temɨte'uxei hepaɨtsita. Xemetsɨ xepɨka'inaki'erie tita temɨtehekɨata.
Xɨka yuri xekate'erieka tita kwiepa mɨtimieme netixekuxaxatɨwakaku, ¿kehepaɨ yuri xepɨte'uta'eriwawe xɨka netixekuxaxatɨwani tita taheima mɨtimiemekɨ?
Xewitɨ taheima pɨka'anutiyeiwe, mɨkɨ taheima makane Yuri Tewitɨtɨ xeikɨa pemarie.
»Muitsexi makumawetsie 'uyeikatɨ kuu muyete hepaɨ, mɨpaɨrita kaneuyewekani Yuri Tewi muyetekienikɨ
yunaitɨ yuri memɨte'erie hetsiena tukari mɨkaxɨwe memexeiyanikɨ.
Kakaɨyari kemɨtiwanaki'erie kwiepa memɨtama
»Kakaɨyari 'ipaɨ katiniwanaki'erieka kwiepa memɨtama. Yuniwe muyuxewi kaniyetuani memɨkatatɨmaiyarienikɨ, yunaitɨ yuri memɨte'erie hetsiena, tukari mɨkaxɨwe memexeiyanikɨ pɨta.
Kakaɨyari kwiepa kemɨreiyenɨ'a yuniwe, mɨpaɨ pɨkatiuyuri mɨwaranutaxɨrienikɨ kwiepa memɨtama. Matsi kwiepa memɨtama memɨtawikweitsitɨarienikɨ kɨmana, 'ayumieme pɨta kaneiyenɨ'ani.
Kemɨ'ane yuri mɨti'erie hetsiena, pɨka'anutahɨiyani. Kemɨ'ane yuri mɨkati'erie 'ari kananutahɨiyaniri, yuri mɨkatita'eriwekɨ kemɨ'ane Kakaɨyari Nu'aya muyuxewi mɨhɨkɨtsie.
'Ipaɨ katiniwaranutaxɨrɨwani 'itsɨkame: Hekɨariya kwiepa kaninuaniri, teɨteri yɨriya mekaninaki'eriekaitɨni, hekɨariya mekanaki'erietɨ, 'axamemɨteyuriekaikɨ.
Yunaitɨ 'axamemɨteyurie mekani'uxieka hekɨariya, hekɨaripa mepɨkakɨniku kapa me'utahekɨatsienikɨ kememɨteyurie.
Kemɨ'ane yamɨtiyuriene tita yuri mɨrainetsie, hekɨaripa paye'axe mɨmatsiɨkɨnikɨ kemɨtiyuriene Kakaɨyari hetsie tiwiyatɨ».
Neneɨkeme teɨtameya kemɨtiyutemawie
Merikɨtsɨ mɨpaɨ tiuyɨku Ketsutsi meta teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama mekanekɨne Kureya kwieyaritsie. Mana wahamatɨa 'ekatineutere ti'ɨyanetɨ.
Wani meta katini'ɨyanekaitɨni 'Enunitsie Tsarimi 'aurie, haa mana waɨkawa muhanekaikɨ. Mekaniu'axekaitɨni mekaniuka'ɨyarɨwakaitɨni.
(Wani katsariyanata pɨka'anutahɨiyawekai 'akuxi).
'Ayumieme Wani hetsɨa miemete teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete hipatɨ huriyutsixi wahamatɨa niuki mekanixɨatɨakaitɨni 'itiya hepaɨtsita.

Wani hetsɨa me'u'axɨaka mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —Ti'ɨkitame, 'iya 'ahamatɨa meyeikakai hatuxame Kurutani 'anutaɨye, kemɨ'ane hepaɨtsita pemɨtihekɨatakai, katine'ɨyaneni hikɨ, meta yunaitɨ hetsɨana mekani'axeni.
Wani mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Tewi pɨkayɨwe tixaɨtɨ mɨtiutanaki'erieni, xɨka taheima miemekɨ yatipitɨarieka xeikɨa pɨyɨwe.
Xemetɨtɨ xekatenihekɨatani nehepaɨtsita kenemainekai: “Ne Kɨritsitu nepɨkahɨkɨ, matsi hɨxiena nemetanɨ'arie nepɨhɨkɨ”.

Kemɨ'ane 'uka wikiwame yuhetsiemieme mexeiya, 'uki neneɨkeme kanihɨkɨtɨni. Neneɨkeme teɨtameya 'auriena mutiwe mi'enie, mɨkɨ kaniyutemawieka neneɨkeme 'enietɨ. 'Ayumieme 'ikɨ netemawierika kanaye'aniri.
Kaneuyeweka mɨkɨ mariwatɨ mayeiximenikɨ, ne pɨta nekamariwatɨ nemayanikɨ.
Kemɨ'ane taheima makane
»Kemɨ'ane taheima makane kanimariweni, kemɨ'ane kwiepa mutine kwiepa kanimiemetɨni, katinikuxatani tita kwiepa mɨtimieme. Kemɨ'ane muyuawitsie makane kanimariweni.
Tita mɨtiuxei, tita mɨtiu'eni, mɨkɨ hepaɨtsita katinihekɨatani. Xewitɨ pɨka'itanaki'eri tita mɨtiutahekɨataxɨ.
Kemɨ'ane mitanaki'eri tita mɨtiutahekɨataxɨ, mɨkɨri matsiɨkɨme kanayeitɨani mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ Kakaɨyari yuri mainekɨ.
Kemɨ'ane Kakaɨyari meiyenɨ'a, mɨkɨ Kakaɨyari niukieyakɨ katinikuxatani, Kakaɨyari kanipitɨani yu'iyari, kemɨreupaɨme kati'inɨatatɨ.
'Ukiyarieya yuniwe kaninaki'erieka, naime katiniyetuirieni mamayatsie.
Kemɨ'ane nu'ayatsie yuri mɨti'erie tukari mɨkaxɨwe kanexeiyani, kemɨ'ane yamɨkatikamie nu'aya kemaine, pɨkaheitimani tukari, matsi Kakaɨyari 'ihekakaku pɨyuhayewa».
